reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is UI ambience enhancement, centered on theme/layout customization (custom background and on-screen control panel), with additional local media playback and equalizer controls as supportive ambience features. Evidence in the README and manifest consistently points to a client-only DeepSeek Harness plugin using theme/slot injection and local setting persistence.

summaries.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness 客户端氛围插件，可设置不遮挡界面的自定义背景，并通过右下角面板播放本地音频、管理播放列表并使用 10 段均衡器调节音效。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness client ambience plugin that lets users add a non-obtrusive custom background and use a bottom-right panel to play local audio with playlist controls and a 10-band equalizer.

capabilities: Provides customizable background image effects (e.g., transparency, blur, fade) for the client interface
Adds a floating control panel in the bottom-right area for user interaction
Supports local background image import for visual ambience
Provides local music playback with playlist, loop, shuffle, and volume control
Includes a 10-band equalizer with preset/preamp/bypass options

reasons.code: Client bundle is configured for DeepSeek Harness web UI injection via slots/theme and immediate load, indicating direct UI/theme customization.
README and package description consistently describe background imagery controls and non-obtrusive overlay behavior as primary features.
Plugin functionality includes local audio playback controls and equalizer settings, but operation is client-side and stored in localStorage.
Repository is public, active, and has valid plugin bundle metadata, with no declared external service runtime dependencies.
